lines: Called peace she two-hands up and down standing risen; to be seen with equal gaze and with hands joined outside.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śāntākhyā sā hastayugmamūrdhvādhaḥ sthitamudgatam samadṛṣṭyāvalokyaṃ ca bahiryojitapāṇikam
